7417.title: Cached usage hides a rejected pooled login
7417.rootCauseOneLine: Account Pooler erases authentication classification; Provider usage discards the account error and serves cached healthy usage with a group warning.
7417.proposedFix: Preserve typed authentication state and model account-scoped stale/error measurements; the full change exceeds simple-fix limits.
7417.caveats: Synthetic OAuth transport; no real account; second run by the same agent. Browser screenshots unavailable because Chrome is absent. Repro code is inline per reports repository policy.
